observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage at a highland games event with hills and tents in the background
observation.dancers: two dancers, one male and one female, competing side-by-side
observation.formation_and_space: two dancers facing forward in a line, staying in place on stage
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture, head up, weight shifting between feet with springy knees
observation.footwork: springing action on the balls of the feet with intricate toe-and-heel touches, hopping on one foot while the other foot touches behind, beside, or in front of the standing ankle
observation.arms_and_hands: arms curved overhead with thumb and index finger touching in a ring, hands occasionally dropping to the waist in a resting pose between figures
observation.hips_and_torso: torso held upright and still, hips level without isolations
observation.levels_jumps_turns: constant springing hops on the spot, no significant floor work or full turns
observation.costume_and_props: traditional highland dancing attire: matching tartan kilts, kilt hose, ghillies, jackets (black for male, blue trimmed with white for female), sporrans, and bonnets with competitor numbers pinned on the front
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and toe-pointing precision are occluded by distance and video resolution

signature_moments.what: dancers spring onto one foot with the other foot held against the calf, arms raised overhead in a curved position
rapid hopping while extending one leg to the side before bringing it back to the ankle
intermittent lowering of hands to hips followed by returning arms overhead
